text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
To conclude this year, 16 runners aiming 
to be the best in Japan! The start of the 
Grand Prix, the Arima Kinen, is just 
moments away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ogurii!! Win again this year!! You're the 
strongest, Oguri!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best, Creek--!! Get revenge for 
last year--!! Prove you're the 
strongest--!"

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
And now, the final showdown of the 
year...! Will it be Oguri Cap and the 
rest... or perhaps...! Everything will be 
decided in this race...!!

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
“—We always dream of the strongest, yet we 
never seek boredom, stagnation, or 
deadlock. Your existence is supposed to be 
the answer to that.”

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Show me, Inari One...! The possibilities 
of this era...! The very pinnacle of the 
Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Folks
text_block_list.text:
Inari-chaaaan!! Let's goooo!! Big Sis 
Inariiii!! Do your beeest!!

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: Show 'em your spirit! Inari!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I can feel the hottest passion of 
the year electrifying through me...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm more nervous than I've ever been in my 
entire life... and more scared than ever, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Even so, that is precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This soul of mine can't help but blaze 
on!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This tension, this fear! It's proof that 
this very moment is my brawl, my festival, 
carrying the hopes of everyone back home!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you...! The spirit of the 
festival, the true essence of "chic"!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Keep your eyes peeled, partner!! Today, 
right here at Nakayama— I'm gonna set off 
some historic fireworks!!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Alright then— I'm off!!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe♪ Inari-chan, what incredible drive—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... something really wonderful 
must have happened.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...She's truly incredible. Just like... a 
flame itself."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I will, too... Meet that passionate fire 
head-on.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(—Yeah. If I just strain these ears of 
mine, I can hear it anytime.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Piercing the heavens, shaking the earth, 
firing up my soul—that stylish, bold 
festival music!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
“—Gather round, gather round! Everyone on 
this side, everyone on that side! Come 
close and lend an ear!”

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Born and raised downtown! The stylish 
Ohi-born Umamusume! A true-blue Edokko, 
Inari One, that's who I am!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What begins now is the Arima Kinen! A 
decisive clash for supremacy!! The grand 
festival of the Twinkle Series!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Watch me become the winner of this race— 
Keep your eyes wide open and glued on me 
until the very end!
